policies.name: Commercial General Liability
policies.description: Protects against third-party claims for bodily injury and property damage.
policies.fullDescription: Commercial General Liability coverage protects your business from claims of bodily injury or property damage to third parties, including premises liability, products-completed operations, and personal and advertising injury.
keyFeatures: Includes Personal and Advertising Injury Liability.
Coverage for Damage to Premises Rented to You up to $300,000.
Medical Expenses coverage for $5,000 per person.

covered: A customer is injured on your business premises and files a lawsuit.
Your advertising causes reputational harm to a competitor.
Property damage occurs to a building you rent due to your negligence.
Medical expenses for a minor injury sustained by a visitor.
notCovered: Damage to your own business property.

policies.name: Commercial Property
policies.description: Protects your business property and income from various perils.
policies.fullDescription: Commercial Property insurance covers your business's physical assets, including buildings, business personal property, and equipment, against perils like fire, wind, and theft. It also includes Business Income and Extra Expense coverage to help you recover lost income after a covered loss.
keyFeatures: Covers Business Personal Property with Replacement Cost valuation.
Provides coverage for Electronic Data Processing equipment and media.
Offers protection for newly acquired or constructed property.
Includes coverage for valuable papers and accounts receivable.
Includes Business Income and Extra Expense coverage for up to 12 consecutive months.
Covers Claim Data Expense and Dependent Properties.
Extended Business Income for 60 consecutive days.

covered: Fire damages your office building and its contents.
A windstorm causes damage to your roof, requiring repairs.
Your computer system breaks down, leading to data loss and business interruption.
Theft of business personal property from your premises.
Your business loses income due to a fire that forces temporary closure.
Extra expenses incurred to operate from a temporary location after a covered loss.
notCovered: Damage caused by flood (unless specifically endorsed).
Losses due to wear and tear or gradual deterioration.
Business interruption due to non-covered perils.
Loss of income beyond the specified period of restoration.

policies.name: Crime Coverage
policies.description: Protects against financial losses from criminal acts.
policies.fullDescription: Crime coverage protects your business from financial losses due to various criminal acts, including employee theft, forgery, and theft of money and securities.
keyFeatures: Coverage for Money Orders and Counterfeit Paper Currency.
Theft, Disappearance and Destruction of Money and Securities, both inside and outside premises.

covered: An employee embezzles funds from the company.
A check is forged, leading to financial loss.
Cash is stolen from the business premises.
Counterfeit currency is accepted in a transaction.
notCovered: Losses not directly resulting from criminal acts.

considerations: Policy proposal is not a binding contract of insurance.
Specific exclusions apply, such as for Digital Assets and certain types of pollution.
Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA) coverage has federal caps and insurer deductibles.
Property policy level deductible applies to certain coverages.
Coverage depends on actual policy provisions, not just the proposal.
coverageStrengths: Comprehensive Commercial General Liability with high limits.
Robust Property coverage including Business Personal Property and Equipment Breakdown.
Extensive Crime coverage for employee theft, forgery, and money/securities.
Includes Business Income and Extra Expense coverage for continuity.
Broad range of endorsements for specific needs.
